Make an impact with NTT DATA

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

 Your day at NTT DATA

 As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).

You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.

Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.

As a go-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

 To thrive in this role, you need to have:

 • Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
• Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
• Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
• Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
• Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
• Client-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
• A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
• Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or relevant work experience.

 On-site Working

 About NTT DATA

 NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters

 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an @nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us .

The group you’ll be a part of

 The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives.

 The impact you’ll make

 In this role, you will directly contribute to the strategy, scalability, and evolution of Lam Research's ServiceNow platform. You will lead architecture and governance efforts across ITSM, ITOM, and ITAM, enabling efficient IT operations, automation, asset management, and enterprise service delivery while driving platform excellence and innovation.

 What You’ll Do

 Define and maintain ServiceNow platform architecture standards, design patterns, and governance frameworks to ensure scalable, secure, and upgrade-ready solutions.

Lead architecture reviews and provide technical oversight for platform enhancements, integrations, and custom applications.

Drive the design and optimization of ITSM capabilities, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, and Service Catalog processes, aligned with ITIL best practices.

Provide technical leadership for ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Event Management while ensuring data quality and CSDM alignment.

Architect and govern IT Asset Management solutions, including HAM Pro and SAM Pro, supporting asset lifecycle management and software compliance initiatives.

Design and oversee enterprise integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Servers, OAuth, and related ServiceNow technologies.

Mentor developers and provide technical leadership across internal teams and implementation partners to promote best practices and continuous platform improvement.

Work in a hybrid environment, collaborating with global stakeholders across multiple geographies and business functions.

 Who We’re Looking For

 12+ years of overall IT experience.

10+ years of hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform.

4+ years of experience as a ServiceNow Technical Architect or Solution Architect.

Deep expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, and ITAM modules.

Strong experience with CMDB architecture, CSDM, Discovery, and Service Mapping.

Experience establishing platform governance, architecture standards, and review processes for enterprise-scale environments.

Strong knowledge of Integration Hub, Flow Designer, MID Servers, REST/SOAP APIs, and enterprise integrations.

 Preferred Qualifications

 ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA).

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Application Developer (CAD).

CIS certifications in ITSM, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM, and SAM.

ITIL v4 certification.

Experience supporting large global ServiceNow environments and multi-partner delivery models

 Our commitment

 We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

 Knowledge

 Skills

• Ability to analyse and validate information from multiple sources.

• Experience with Service Portfolio Management.

 As our ServiceNow Platform Engineer, you be part of our Solution Centre of Excellence team where we strongly believe that working hard and having fun are two compatible elements. 

 We are looking for a proactive and experienced ServiceNow Platform Engineer to join our team and play a key role in supporting our ServiceNow instance. You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, bringing support expertise to the team. 

 

 Key Responsibilities:

 
 Troubleshooting and issue resolution  
 
Responsible for diagnosing and fixing issues identified with our ServiceNow instance to minimise disruptions and keep systems fully operational.  

 Effective case management

 System maintenance  
 
Perform routine maintenance tasks to prevent issues before they arise. 

 Documentation and reporting  
 
Documentation is vital — keeping detailed records of technical issues, solutions provided and system updates helps technical support specialists maintain consistent support and communication with other technical teams.  

 Development & Configuration 
 
Provide support to the development to help to implement configuration and minor development changes

 User support and training   

Assisting users with understanding and using technology effectively is a major focus, including providing training on new systems and software.

• 4+ years of experience working with ServiceNow CSM and ITSM.

• Strong understanding of customer service workflows and ServiceNow capabilities.

• Awareness of ServiceNow ITOM and its integration points.

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and documentation skills.

• Strong team player with experience working in global delivery models.

 

 Qualifications: 

 
 

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• ITIL Foundation certification.

• Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience working with enterprise-scale applications.

 

 Additional Information

 We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Role: ServiceNow Production Support Manager

 Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad

 Experience: 10+ years

 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Role Summary

 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Production Support Manager to lead and manage 24x7 production support operations for a large-scale ServiceNow environment supporting critical business services. This role is responsible for ensuring platform stability, operational excellence, service availability, incident reduction, and continuous improvement across multiple ServiceNow applications and modules.

The ideal candidate will have strong ServiceNow platform knowledge, proven leadership experience managing global support teams, and the ability to work in rotational shifts to support business-critical operations across multiple time zones.

 Key Responsibilities

 ServiceNow Platform Management

 • Support ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Catalog, Integration Hub, and custom applications.
• Coordinate platform upgrades, patching, maintenance activities, and releases.
• Review platform risks and implement mitigation strategies.
• Ensure compliance with security, audit, and governance requirements.

 Production Operations Management

 • Lead end-to-end production support for ServiceNow platform and associated applications.
• Manage day-to-day operations, incident queues, escalations, and operational governance.
• Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, and operational KPIs.
• Drive continuous service improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
• Monitor platform health, availability, performance, and capacity.

 Incident & Problem Management

 • Act as escalation manager for critical incidents and service disruptions.
• Lead Major Incident Management (MIM) activities and stakeholder communications.
• Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and drive preventive action plans.
• Ensure timely resolution of incidents and reduce recurring issues.

 Team Leadership

 • Manage and mentor ServiceNow production support engineers across multiple shifts.
• Oversee workforce planning, shift scheduling, and on-call coverage.
• Drive team performance, knowledge management, and professional development.
• Establish operational standards, SOPs, and support playbooks.

 Transition & Vendor Management

 • Lead knowledge transfer and transition activities from vendors or managed service providers.
• Coordinate with engineering, development, infrastructure, and business teams.
• Track deliverables, risks, dependencies, and operational readiness.

 Reporting & Governance

 • Present operational metrics and service health updates to leadership.
• Track KPIs include:
 • SLA compliance
• MTTR
• Incident volumes
• Change success rate
• Problem backlog
• Service availability

• Drive executive reviews and operational governance meetings.

 Required Qualifications

 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
• 10+ years of IT operations and production support experience in ServiceNow Platform.
• 5+ years of experience managing ServiceNow production support teams.
• Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and service management practices.
• Experience supporting large enterprise ServiceNow environments.
• Experience leading global teams in a 24x7 operational model.

 Preferred Skills

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS).
• ITIL Foundation or ITIL Intermediate certification.
• Knowledge of SRE principles, automation, monitoring, and platform reliability.
• Experience with Agile, DevOps, and Continual Service Improvement (CSI).
• Telecom industry experience preferred.

 Key Competencies

 • Leadership and people management
• Stakeholder management
• Crisis management and decision making
• Operational strategy and execution
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 Shift Requirement

 • Must be willing to work in rotational shifts supporting a global 24x7 environment.
• Participate in on-call rotations and major incident bridges as required.
• Ability to support weekend releases, maintenance windows, and critical business events.

Join Verdantas – A Top #ENR 73 Firm,

We at Verdantas, seeking for a Knowledge Management Lead to lead ServiceNow Knowledge Management, driving governance, content quality, self-service, and AI/Copilot-enabled knowledge solutions.

 Key Responsibilities

 Knowledge Governance & Management

 • Own the Knowledge Management strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with ITIL Knowledge Management practices 
• Define and enforce knowledge governance policies, standards, and content guidelines
• Establish and enforce article ownership and accountability, including defined knowledge owners and contributors 
• Define knowledge base structure, taxonomy, and access controls within ServiceNow 
• Act as the Knowledge Management product owner, balancing platform capabilities and business needs 
• Own the day-to-day operation of the ServiceNow Knowledge module, including publishing workflows, approvals, and content governance enforcement

 Knowledge Lifecycle Management

 • Own the end-to-end knowledge lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, publication, maintenance, and retirement 
• Enforce adherence to lifecycle processes across all teams, including mandatory reviews, approvals, and retirement of outdated content
• Ensure outdated, duplicate, or unused content is identified and addressed 
• Establish workflows to support consistent content lifecycle execution across all teams

 Content Standards & Quality Management

 • Define and enforce content standards for structure, format, and readability 
• Ensure all articles are actionable, task-oriented, and audience-appropriate (end users vs. IT staff) 
• Establish and maintain a single source of truth by eliminating duplicate or conflicting content
• Ensure knowledge is structured to support search effectiveness and AI/Copilot consumption
• Drive continuous improvement of content quality based on usage and feedback 

 Cross-Functional Adoption & Enablement

 • Drive adoption of ServiceNow Knowledge across IT and business functions (HR, Finance, Marketing, etc.) 
• Partner with business stakeholders to define knowledge use cases, ownership models, and content structures 
• Provide training, guidance, and onboarding for knowledge contributors and owners 
• Establish ServiceNow as the centralized, authoritative platform for knowledge management across the organization
• Define and scale a federated knowledge ownership model enabling business units to create, manage, and maintain content within a governed framework

 Reporting, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

 • Define and deliver knowledge performance metrics, including: 
• Article usage and effectiveness 
• Search success and self-service adoption 
• Content quality and lifecycle compliance 
• Provide reporting and insights to leadership on knowledge health and adoption 
• Drive knowledge base cleanup initiatives, including duplicate removal, content improvement, and ownership alignment 
• Continuously improve processes based on data, trends, and stakeholder feedback 
• Track and report on article ownership, coverage, and contribution activity across teams

 Service Integration & Platform Ownership

 • Drive integration of knowledge into Incident, Request, and Problem Management processes to improve resolution efficiency and consistency
• Ensure alignment with Problem Management, including creation and maintenance of Known Error and workaround articles
• Partner with Service Desk to improve knowledge usage during ticket resolution 
• Collaborate with ServiceNow platform teams on enhancements, workflows, and automation

Job Description

 Key Responsibilities:

 CMDB Configuration and Customization:

 • Configure, maintain, and update ServiceNow CMDB, and related plugins, Workspaces and their components and features to meet business requirements.
• Develop and maintain workflows, forms, scripts, and automation processes as needed.
• Implement new functionalities and enhancements, including planning and testing for upcoming upgrades and patching.
• Configure and support components required to support the CSDM framework.
• Ensure CMDB Health and Integrity KPI’s are consistently maintained.
• Consult with, and support the requirements needed of CMDB, by application and module product owners and developers.

 CMDB Data Sources Configuration and Maintenance:

 • Configure and maintain ITOM Visibility applications and related supporting components, including Mid Servers and their functionality.
• Configure and maintain Service Graph and its connectors.
• Configure and maintain Integration Hub spokes and integrations related to CMDB.
• Maintain platform security and compliance with organizational policies.

 CMDB and Data Sources Maintenance and Upgrades:

 • Perform regular maintenance, including monitoring performance and conducting health checks.
• Plan and execute upgrades and patches for CMDB and ITOM Visibility components and related plugins, ensuring minimal disruption to services.
• Coordinate with vendors or internal groups for maintenance, changes, and enhancements to data sources or CMDB configuration and settings.

 CMDB Integrity Management:

 • Provide technical support for CMDB+CSDM, ITOM Visibility, Service Graph, and Integration Hub related issues, troubleshooting problems, and implementing solutions.
• Utilize Data Manager lifecycle attestion to provide integrity audit. Collaborate with IT teams to resolve CMDB inventory and other integrity issues, to prevent future occurrences and maintain a healthy CMDB.
• Perform daily Discovery, and other data source, log validation, and consult with IT teams to resolve any issues causing inventory issues.

 Integration Management:

 • Manage integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using SOAP, REST, and other relevant technologies.
• Ensure data consistency and integrity across integrated platforms.

 Documentation and Training:

 • Create and maintain technical documentation, including configuration, process, procedure, policy, and architectural design.
• Create and provide reporting on CMDB status and health, and planned enhancements, changes and projects.
• Provide training and support to end-users and stakeholders to promote effective CMDB+CSDM use.

 Compliance and Governance:

 • Ensure adherence to platform and CMDB governance, management, and compliance standards as outlined in organizational manuals, policy, and internal departmental documents.
• Conduct regular audits and reviews to maintain compliance with internal and external regulations.

 Qualifications:

 Education:

 • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

 Experience Requirements:

 • 3-5 years of experience within an enterprise environment for ServiceNow CMDB + CSDM, and ITOM Visibility administration, configuration, operational support and enhancement development.
• Experience working across multiple ServiceNow instances (Production, Sub-Production, Dev, Test).
• Strong understanding of Configuration Management, under the Common Service Data Model, their relation to and in support of Asset Management.
• Knowledge of CMDB+CSDM relation to, and use of, foundational core data and their combined relation to and support provided to ITSM, CSM, SPM, and SecOps application modules.
• Strong experience with ITOM Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph, Integration Hub, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), within a multi-source CMDB environment.
• Strong experience with Discovery pattern configuration and customization through Pattern Designer, custom classes, and probes and sensors.
• Strong experience deploying, configuring, and supporting Mid Servers and all of their capabilities.
• Experience with on-prem and cloud environment Discovery and schedules.
• Experience with Service Graph Connector configuration for resource and OS-level discovery for at least AWS and Azure environments.
• Experience working within relevant Workspaces for CMDB, Discovery Admin, and Cloud Discovery.
• Experience working within CMDB Data Manager, and building templates and processing tasks for de-duplication, and lifecycle management.
• Experience with supporting changes for CMDB and ITOM Visibility during instance upgrade, and patching.
• Hands-on experience with workflow automation, scripting, and integrations.
• Familiarity with ITIL framework and change management processes.
• Experience working across a combined TeamSpace(Project) and Agile development environment.

 Technical Skills:

 ServiceNow CMDB Administration & Configuration

 • Provide support for implementing new business initiatives, new functionality, projects and requests involving CMDB, CSDM, ITOM Visibility, and Service Graph.
• Configuration, support and enhancement of CMDB, CSDM, ITOM Visibility, and Service Graph.
• CMDB and Discovery process oversight, health monitoring, issue remediation, maintenance processes, and status and trend reporting.
• Provide support to agile development teams for implementing enhancements.
• Plan, Test, and implement plugin and application upgrades for CMDB, CSDM, ITOM Visibility, and Service Graph.

 Scripting & Development

 • JavaScript, GlideScript, and AngularJS for ServiceNow scripting.
• Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions for automation.
• ServiceNow Flow Designer and Orchestration for process automation.

 Integrations & Data Management

 • REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and MID Servers for third-party integrations.
• Data Management jobs for CI maintenance.
• CMDB data source integrations, Service Graph, and Service Mapping.

 Reporting & Analytics

 • Custom dashboards, Performance Analytics, and scheduled reports.
• KPI tracking and real-time monitoring using Performance Analytics Widgets.

 Compliance & Governance

 • Maintain adherence to CSDM guidelines for CMDB
• ITIL processes, GDPR compliance where applicable.
• Participation in audits, governance meetings, and license audits.

 Preferred Certifications (Optional, but Highly Desirable):

 • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Discovery (CIS-D) (Required)
• CMDB Fundamentals ILT (Micro-Certification) (Required)
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• ITIL 4 Foundation Certification

 Key Competencies:

 • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.
• Adaptability to evolving technologies and processes.

 Enterprise Performance 

 Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement. • Integrate ServiceNow GRC with enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, MID Server, or Integration Hub to support automated evidence collection and cross-platform workflows 
• Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, security, audit, legal, compliance, and business functions to align risk and compliance processes 
• Support testing, UAT, release planning, defect resolution, documentation, and post-production support 
• Recommend process improvements using current IRM trends such as continuous compliance monitoring, smart automation, and AI-enabled workflows 

 Required Qualifications

 • 6-10 years Hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform, including configuration and administration of GRC / IRM modules 
• Strong understanding of governance, risk, and compliance principles, enterprise risk management, and control frameworks 
• Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting concepts including Glide, Business Rules, and Flow Designer 
• Experience with integration methods such as REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Integration Hub 
• Familiarity with compliance and security frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, or FedRAMP 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills 

 Preferred Qualifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) 
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Risk and Compliance (CIS-RC) 
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) 
• Experience with Vendor Risk Management or Third-Party Risk Management implementations 

 Preferred Skills

 • Risk assessment design

• Audit lifecycle support 
• Workflow automation 
• Dashboard and KPI development 
• Stakeholder workshops 
• Integration troubleshooting 
• Documentation and training

 ServiceNow TPRM - Consultant

 Enterprise Performance

 Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement.  Level : Consultant or equivalent

As a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments.  Work you'll do

 We are seeking a skilled ServiceNow Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Developer to design, implement, and support ServiceNow TPRM solutions that strengthen vendor governance, risk visibility, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring.  Key Responsibilities

 • Implement and configure ServiceNow TPRM / TPRP capabilities, including third-party records, contacts, inherent risk questionnaires, due diligence workflows, issues, and remediation tracking

• Partner with Risk, Compliance, Procurement, Security, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and align workflows
• Build dashboards, reports, and monitoring views for third-party risk status, compliance posture, assessment completion, and remediation progress
• Maintain documentation for solution design, configuration, workflows, and operating procedures
• Support continuous improvement of third-party onboarding, reassessment, escalation, and offboarding processes

 Required Qualifications

 • 3-6 years hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform and strong exposure to TPRM, IRM, or GRC modules
• Solid understanding of third-party risk, vendor risk, compliance processes, control frameworks, and risk scoring methodologies
• Experience with ServiceNow configuration and development, including workflows, Business Rules, reporting, dashboards, and preferably JavaScript
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with external vendor, risk, or enterprise platforms using APIs and standard web services
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills

 Preferred Qualifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Third-Party Risk Management (CIS-TPRM)
• ServiceNow CIS in GRC / IRM for broader integrated risk roles
• Industry certifications such as CRISC, CISM, or privacy/risk credentials
• Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or critical infrastructure

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: 24x7 including night shift as per business requirements

 Job Description

 About The Role:

 The Platform Architect is a trusted advisor for enterprise platform strategy and governance. You define platform standards and guide technical decisions to ensure ServiceNow remains healthy, scalable, and aligned to customer goals.

Your purpose is to establish governance models, anticipate risks, and enable sustainable growth. You engage across executives, enterprise architects, and platform teams to influence decisions and ensure consistency across the program.

 What You Will Do

 • Define and maintain platform vision and strategy aligned to enterprise IT and business objectives.
• Provide architectural guidance to ensure designs align with platform standards and leading practices.
• Shape governance frameworks covering instance strategy, integrations, and data models.
• Facilitate platform governance forums to drive consistent decisions across partners and teams.
• Anticipate and mitigate platform risks (scalability, performance, technical debt).
• Influence adoption of leading practices across customer, partner, and ServiceNow teams.
• Provide structured feedback to ServiceNow product and engineering teams.
• Travel of up to 50% annually may be expected.

 What Success Looks Like

 • ServiceNow is embedded as a strategic enterprise platform with clear governance models in place.
• Platform standards are consistently applied across all delivery teams.
• Technical risks are reduced, and scalability is maintained.
• You are recognised as a trusted advisor on platform strategy and governance, complementing the CSE’s business-value leadership.

 Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

 • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution strategy, and program leadership.
• Proven experience engaging at Executive level to influence platform direction and business outcomes.
• Track record of defining enterprise-scale architectures and governance models.
• Expertise in platform strategy, integration patterns, and delivery governance.
• ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) plus other architecture and governance framework certifications are highly desirable.

 Why This Role Is Different

 • This role is about shaping the long-term health and scalability of the ServiceNow platform. As a Platform Architect, you’ll influence strategy and governance at enterprise scale, guiding decisions that make the platform a trusted foundation for business transformation.
• It’s a role for architects who want to work at the strategic level, helping customers run the platform as an asset, not just a solution.

 Your day at NTT DATA

 As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).

You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.

Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.

As a go-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

 To thrive in this role, you need to have:

 • Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
• Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
• Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
• Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
• Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
• Client-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
• A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.

 Position Summary 

 ServiceNow CMDB - Senior Consultant 

 Enterprise Performance

 Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement. Within this space, our teams work across IT operations, service management, workflow automation, and enterprise platforms to deliver large-scale digital transformation programs. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that help clients streamline processes, improve service delivery, and create long-term business value.

 Level : Senior Consultant or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

 Work you'll do

 As a Senior Consultant, Technical on the Enterprise Operations Portfolio team, you will be responsible for:

 Governance: Develop and enforce CMDB policies, procedures, and standards.

Define and maintain the CMDB scope, including identification and reconciliation of critical CIs.

Establish and monitor CMDB performance metrics to ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs)

Lead the discussions with stakeholders (internal and external)

Provide resolutions for conflicts/ challenges

 CMDB Design and Implementation: Collaborate with stakeholders to define CMDB requirements and design.

Configure and customize the CMDB tool to align with organizational needs.

Implement and maintain CI relationships, hierarchies, and attributes.

 CI Lifecycle Management: Establish and maintain a process for CI identification, reconciliation, classification, and labelling.

Coordinate and oversee the CI registration, verification, and documentation process.

Ensure accurate and timely updates to the CMDB for all CI changes, including additions, modifications, and retirements.

 Data Integrity and Quality:

 Develop and implement data quality controls to ensure CMDB accuracy and completeness.

Conduct regular audits to identify and resolve data inconsistencies or discrepancies.

Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and improve data accuracy.

 Change and Release Management Integration: Collaborate with Change and Release Management teams to ensure CMDB is updated with approved changes and releases.

Facilitate the impact analysis of proposed changes on CIs and related services.

Provide CMDB data for change impact assessments and change advisory board (CAB) meetings.

 Reporting and Analysis: Generate and distribute Custom CMDB reports and dashboards to stakeholders.

Analyse CMDB data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement.

Provide insights and recommendations for optimizing IT asset and configuration management processes.

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: 24x7 including night shift as per business requirements

 Qualifications

 Required :

 • 6-10 years of ServiceNow development experience in large enterprise environments
• Experience configuring and developing ServiceNow using UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Access Control Lists (ACLs), Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets, and MID Server configuration
• Experience with JavaScript, HyperText Markup Language (HTML), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Bootstrap, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), Representational State Transfer (REST), and Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP)
• Experience delivering solutions across ServiceNow products such as IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), or custom applications

• Risk Management
• Policy & Compliance

• Regulatory Change Management

 • Design and implement BCM capabilities including:
• Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
• Continuity Planning
• Recovery Management
• Crisis Response Workflows
• Configure continuity plans, process dependencies, recovery objectives, and resilience workflows.
• Support continuity testing, simulation exercises, and recovery readiness initiatives.
• Enable operational resilience through integrated ServiceNow workflows and automation.

## Security Operations (SecOps)

 • Lead implementations across ServiceNow SecOps modules including:
• Security Incident Response (SIR)
• Vulnerability Response
• Threat Intelligence integrations
• Design workflows for incident triage, threat prioritization, vulnerability remediation, and coordinated response.
• Integrate ServiceNow with security tools such as SIEM, vulnerability scanners, EDR, and threat intelligence platforms.
• Enable visibility into security posture, risk exposure, and operational KPIs through dashboards and reporting.

## Development & Integrations

• JavaScript
• Glide API
• Script Includes
• Business Rules
• Client Scripts
• Flow Designer
• IntegrationHub
• Build and maintain REST/SOAP integrations with enterprise applications and security platforms.
• Design reusable workflows, automation components, and scalable integrations.
• Support platform upgrades, release activities, and performance improvements.

## Leadership & Governance

 • Mentor developers and administrators across implementation and support activities.
• Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.
• Ensure compliance with enterprise standards and ServiceNow development best practices.
• Collaborate with QA, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams during deployments and production releases.

• IRM / GRC
• BCM
• SecOps

• JavaScript
• Glide API
• Flow Designer
• ServiceNow scripting
• REST/SOAP integrations
• Experience implementing:
• Security Incident Response
• Vulnerability Response
• Risk & Compliance workflows
• Business Continuity processes
• Good understanding of:
• CMDB
• Enterprise integrations
• Security operations
• Governance and compliance frameworks

• SIEM tools
• Vulnerability scanners

 Position Summary 

 ServiceNow TPRM - Senior Consultant 

 Enterprise Performance 

 Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement. Within this space, our teams work across IT operations, service management, workflow automation, and enterprise platforms to deliver large-scale digital transformation programs. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that help clients streamline processes, improve service delivery, and create long-term business value.

 Level : Senior Consultant or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

 Work you'll do 

 We are seeking a skilled ServiceNow Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Developer to design, implement, and support ServiceNow TPRM solutions that strengthen vendor governance, risk visibility, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring. The ideal candidate combines functional knowledge of third-party risk processes with hands-on ServiceNow IRM / GRC platform expertise and can translate business requirements into scalable workflows, assessments, dashboards, and integrations.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Implement and configure ServiceNow TPRM / TPRP capabilities, including third-party records, contacts, inherent risk questionnaires, due diligence workflows, issues, and remediation tracking 
• Design and maintain risk assessments, scoring models, approval flows, questionnaires, and risk rating logic 
• Integrate TPRM with broader IRM / GRC capabilities, vendor management processes, and CMDB where applicable 
• Partner with Risk, Compliance, Procurement, Security, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and align workflows 
• Build dashboards, reports, and monitoring views for third-party risk status, compliance posture, assessment completion, and remediation progress 
• Maintain documentation for solution design, configuration, workflows, and operating procedures 
• Support continuous improvement of third-party onboarding, reassessment, escalation, and offboarding processes 

 Required Qualifications

 • 6-10 years hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform and strong exposure to TPRM, IRM, or GRC modules 
• Solid understanding of third-party risk, vendor risk, compliance processes, control frameworks, and risk scoring methodologies 
• Experience with ServiceNow configuration and development, including workflows, Business Rules, reporting, dashboards, and preferably JavaScript 
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with external vendor, risk, or enterprise platforms using APIs and standard web services 
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills 

 Preferred Qualifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) 
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Third-Party Risk Management (CIS-TPRM) 
• ServiceNow CIS in GRC / IRM for broader integrated risk roles 
• Industry certifications such as CRISC, CISM, or privacy/risk credentials 
• Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or critical infrastructure 

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: 24x7 including night shift as per business requirements

 EY-ServiceNow – Manager - ITOM Technical Architect

 As part of our EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using the ServiceNow platform, specifically focusing on IT Operations Management (ITOM). You will get an opportunity to work with a high-quality team and build innovative solutions that address complex enterprise challenges.

 The opportunity

 We’re looking for a Technical Architect with expertise in ServiceNow ITOM architecture and implementation to join the EY GDS ServiceNow team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in driving ITOM transformation and platform strategy for global clients.

 Your Key Responsibilities

 • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management
• Define and implement scalable CMDB architecture, governance frameworks, and data models
• Drive end-to-end ITOM strategy, aligning ServiceNow capabilities with enterprise IT operations and business goals
• Architect and deliver event correlation, observability, and AIOps solutions using ServiceNow Event Management and integrations
• Design and implement Service Mapping solutions for business services and applications
• Lead Discovery implementation, including MID Server setup, credential management, and troubleshooting
• Drive integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and third-party monitoring tools
• Provide technical leadership and mentoring to development and implementation teams
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical and architectural specifications
• Ensure adherence to platform best practices, governance, and security standards
• Support performance tuning, scalability optimization, and platform upgrades
• Drive DevOps and Agile delivery practices across ITOM implementations
• Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance

 Skills And Attributes For Success

 • Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, Cloud Management
• Deep understanding of CMDB data modeling, CSDM framework, and data governance
• Experience in AIOps, event correlation, and monitoring tool integrations (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds)
• Knowledge of infrastructure technologies: servers, networks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Strong JavaScript, Glide scripting, and ServiceNow platform development skills
• Experience with REST/SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

 To qualify for the role, you must have

 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
• Approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with significant exposure to ServiceNow ITOM
• Proven experience as a Technical Architect or Lead in ServiceNow ITOM implementations
• ServiceNow CSA certification (mandatory)
• ServiceNow CIS – Discovery / Service Mapping (mandatory)
• ITIL Foundation certification (preferred)

 Ideally, you’ll also have

 • Experience with CSDM adoption and enterprise CMDB strategy
• Exposure to multi-cloud environments and cloud discovery
• Knowledge of latest ServiceNow releases and features

 What We Look For

 • A team of people with strong technical expertise, consulting mindset, and innovation-driven approach
• Individuals passionate about digital transformation and IT operations modernization
• Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced global environment
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills

 Position Summary 

 Cyber 

 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

 Position Summary

 Level: Senior Consultant 

 As a Security Engineer III, you will support the design, implementation, and optimization of ServiceNow Security Operations solutions, with a focus on Vulnerability Response and related workflow automation. This role offers the opportunity to work with client stakeholders to improve vulnerability management processes, strengthen data quality, and drive scalable remediation outcomes across the enterprise.

 Work you'll do

 As a Security Engineer III on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for…

 • Designing and implementing ServiceNow Security Operations solutions, including data models, workflows, access controls, and application configurations
• Configuring and administering ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and Configuration Compliance modules, including source onboarding, assignment rules, service-level agreements, notifications, and remediation tasks
• Integrating ServiceNow with vulnerability scanners and other third-party tools, and validating data mapping, configuration item matching, schedules, and error handling
• Building automation using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and Representational State Transfer application programming interfaces to support routing, approvals, escalations, enrichment, and remediation verification
• Partnering with client security, information technology, and operations stakeholders to run workshops, define requirements, create user stories, and align configurations to business risk and remediation processes
• Developing dashboards, documentation, update sets, and role-based access controls, while providing technical guidance to junior team members

 The team

 Cyber Strategy & Transformation teams develop and transform cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. They keep the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and give stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Services include the design of cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments. Services also encompass Cybersecurity Assessments and Frameworks, Cyber Transformation Management, Technology Software and Asset Compliance Management, Third Party Risk Management, Cyber Risk and Compliance, Solution Design and Implementation, and Cyber Risk Analytics and Quantification Reporting.

 Qualifications

 Required:

 • 4-8 years of ServiceNow administration, development, or platform experience
• 3+ years of ServiceNow Security Operations or Vulnerability Response implementation experience
• Experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
• Experience with vulnerability management lifecycle processes, including scan, triage, prioritization, remediation, and verification
• Experience with Configuration Management Database, asset data, configuration item matching, ownership, or criticality management
• Experience developing ServiceNow JavaScript using GlideRecord, Business Rules, Script Includes, or User Interface Policies
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology or a specified field

Preferred:

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification
• ServiceNow Vulnerability Response or Security Operations certification
• Experience with Configuration Compliance, Threat Intelligence, Security Incident Response, Governance Risk and Compliance, or Integrated Risk Management modules
• Experience with performance tuning or large-scale data ingestion in ServiceNow

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: General Shift

Summary

 Position Summary 

 Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant 

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.

 Work you will do 

 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant , you would be expected to perform the following activities:

 • Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations. 
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service. 
• Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns. 
• Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen. 
• Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration. 
• Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions. 
• Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations. 
• Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities. 

 Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)

 • Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking. 
• Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions. 
• Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling. 
• Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities. 
• Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. 
• Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation. 
• Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload. 
• Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management. 
• Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response. 
• Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements. 

 Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)

 Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.

 Required Qualifications

 • 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform). 
• Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response. 
• Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes. 
• Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing. 
• Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer). 
• Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders. 

 Preferred / Nice To Have

 • ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications. 
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms. 
• Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion. 

 Core Skills

 ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.

 Education: 

 • Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

 Location: 

 • Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

job_title: MIM, Change & Problem Management - Engineer Service Management
job_description:
What Success Looks Like In This Role

 Job Title: MIM, Change & Problem Management - Engineer Service Management

 Location : Bangalore

 Who We Are

 Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.

 Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

 Our Core Beliefs

 • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
• Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
• Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
• Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

 Position Overview

 Oversees, facilitates and administers ITIL based service support. Manages and oversees Unisys service delivery through processes, including incident, major incident, problem, request and change management with a focus on improving overall service quality. Coordinates client-facing resources and potentially client and client partners to facilitate compliance with service quality commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Major Incident Management (MIM)

 • Provide operational support for Major Incident Management activities across assigned accounts.
• Coordinate Major Incident bridge calls and engage technical resolver teams to expedite service restoration.
• Gather, validate, and document incident details, business impact, affected services, and timelines.
• Ensure timely stakeholder communications during incident lifecycle including identification, escalation, recovery, and closure.
• Track incident progress, action items, and ownership to maintain momentum toward resolution.
• Assist in conducting post-incident reviews and documenting root cause analysis (RCA).
• Ensure MIM documentation, communication templates, and knowledge repositories are maintained and updated.
• Monitor compliance with MIM process requirements and escalation procedures.
• Identify recurring incident trends and collaborate with Problem Management for long-term remediation.

Change Management (CM)

 • Review Change Requests for completeness, quality, risk assessment, implementation plans, and rollback readiness.
• Monitor change schedules and facilitate conflict detection, impact analysis, and risk mitigation activities.
• Coordinate and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
• Ensure compliance with Change Management policies, procedures, and governance controls.
• Perform post-implementation reviews (PIRs) and track remediation actions for failed or backed-out changes.
• Monitor emergency and unauthorized changes and escalate process violations as appropriate.
• Maintain change calendars and support planning activities across multiple stakeholders.
• Produce change-related dashboards, compliance reports, and governance metrics.
• Drive continual improvement initiatives aimed at reducing change-related incidents and service disruptions.

Problem Management (PM)

 • Facilitate identification, logging, categorization, prioritization, and tracking of problem records.
• Coordinate Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings and follow-up activities.

Function/Department: Information Technology / Infrastructure Services

 Reports to: Director Engineering and Tools

 Location: Mahadevapura Hobli, Bangaluru, Karnataka, India

 Job Summary:

 Fortive is seeking a skilled and motivated ServiceNow developer with a strong focus on ITOM, CMDB/CSDM (Configuration Management Database/Common Service Data Model), Application Mapping, and Vulnerability Management. This role is central to supporting and advancing our global ServiceNow environment, with a particular emphasis on ensuring the integrity, completeness, and security of configuration data. Candidates will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow solutions that align with business requirements and best practices.

Candidates will work closely with architects, stakeholders, and external partners to enhance workflows, automate processes, and ensure platform supportability, performance, and upgradability. They will be responsible for development, documentation, test plans and the transition of developed solutions to our ServiceNow Operations team for business-as-usual support.

The ideal candidate should be a self-starter ensuring CMDB data integrity and support core ITOM and related processes across the enterprise. They are able to work independently within a technical team and be comfortable operating in a fast-paced organization. If you are passionate about transforming IT services and thrive in a dynamic, global setting, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity!

 Primary Responsibilities And Job Duties:

 • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of ITOM, CMDB and CSDM, applying robust controls to ensure configuration data quality and accuracy across multiple sources.
• Design and implement ServiceNow Application Mapping to visualize and manage relationships between infrastructure components and business applications. 
• Implement integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise applications, especially those that enhance ITOM, CMDB, and Vulnerability Management capabilities.
• Define and enforce CMDB governance & data quality standards
• Deep understanding of ServiceNow MID-server architecture and the role it plays in Discovery optimization, discovery patterns, Discovery schedules and cloud discovery.
• Perform data audits, health checks, and reconciliation.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in ITSM, ITOM, Asset & Vulnerability to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions for process alignment.
• Work across other ServiceNow modules and capabilities according to demand.
• Design and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform. 
• Ensure compliance with ServiceNow development standards, low-code/no-code, configuration-not-customization and other best practices.
• Maintain a high standard of code quality by writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code optimizing for performance
• Act as Tier 3 escalation point for the ServiceNow Operations team to assist with resolution of issues with ServiceNow applications or integrations. 
• Stay updated with the latest ServiceNow features and enhancements and recommend improvements.
• Communicate technical problems and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
• Participate in process design workshops and kaizen events.
• Occasional travel both nationally and internationally.
• Other Duties as assigned or required.

 Qualifications

 Required:

 • 3+ years of experience in ServiceNow development and administration, with proven expertise in ITOM, CMDB, Application Mapping, and Vulnerability Management.
• Deep understanding of ServiceNow MID-server architecture and the role it plays in Discovery optimization, discovery patterns, Discovery schedules, Cloud discovery, Event Management
• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure—including servers, networks, storage, virtualization, and cloud services—is essential for accurately modeling configuration items and their relationships within a CMDB.
• Track record of driving CMDB and CSDM adoption, preferably with evidence of applying controls around configuration data quality across multiple sources
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
• Proven bias for low-code/no-code approaches to development.
• Proficiency in JavaScript, Glide API, and ServiceNow scripting.
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with other enterprise systems.
• Familiarity with the Agile methodology and working with Stories and Sprints to deliver new capabilities.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
• Ability to lead small projects with manageable risks.
• Comfortable working in a lean, fast-paced technology environment with high expectations.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while delivering results.
• Acts as a mentor and resource for other colleagues.

 Preferred:

 • Experience with Service Portal/Employee Center, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, NowAssist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Performance Analytics, Platform Analytics, Event Management, Health Log Analytics, dashboards and reporting.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

 Job Title: MIM, Change & Problem Management - Engineer Service Management

 Location : Bangalore

 Who We Are

 Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.

 Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

 Our Core Beliefs

 • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
• Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
• Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
• Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

 Position Overview

 Oversees, facilitates and administers ITIL based service support. Manages and oversees Unisys service delivery through processes, including incident, major incident, problem, request and change management with a focus on improving overall service quality. Coordinates client-facing resources and potentially client and client partners to facilitate compliance with service quality commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Major Incident Management (MIM)

 • Provide operational support for Major Incident Management activities across assigned accounts.
• Coordinate Major Incident bridge calls and engage technical resolver teams to expedite service restoration.
• Gather, validate, and document incident details, business impact, affected services, and timelines.
• Ensure timely stakeholder communications during incident lifecycle including identification, escalation, recovery, and closure.
• Track incident progress, action items, and ownership to maintain momentum toward resolution.
• Assist in conducting post-incident reviews and documenting root cause analysis (RCA).
• Ensure MIM documentation, communication templates, and knowledge repositories are maintained and updated.
• Monitor compliance with MIM process requirements and escalation procedures.
• Identify recurring incident trends and collaborate with Problem Management for long-term remediation.

Change Management (CM)

 • Review Change Requests for completeness, quality, risk assessment, implementation plans, and rollback readiness.
• Monitor change schedules and facilitate conflict detection, impact analysis, and risk mitigation activities.
• Coordinate and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
• Ensure compliance with Change Management policies, procedures, and governance controls.
• Perform post-implementation reviews (PIRs) and track remediation actions for failed or backed-out changes.
• Monitor emergency and unauthorized changes and escalate process violations as appropriate.
• Maintain change calendars and support planning activities across multiple stakeholders.
• Produce change-related dashboards, compliance reports, and governance metrics.
• Drive continual improvement initiatives aimed at reducing change-related incidents and service disruptions.

Problem Management (PM)

 • Facilitate identification, logging, categorization, prioritization, and tracking of problem records.
• Coordinate Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings and follow-up activities.
• Ensure root cause analysis is conducted and documented for high-impact incidents and recurring issues.
• Track corrective and preventive actions through closure.
• Monitor known errors and workaround documentation for operational teams.
• Analyze incident trends and identify potential problem candidates.
• Collaborate with technical teams to drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
• Measure and report effectiveness of problem management activities and preventive actions.
• Support continual service improvement by identifying opportunities to reduce incident recurrence.

Governance, Reporting & Process Compliance

 • Generate and distribute service management reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI metrics.
• Monitor process compliance across MIM, Change, and Problem Management functions.
• Conduct regular audits of service management records and process adherence.
• Participate in governance reviews, operational meetings, and client service reviews.
• Support internal and external audit requirements through evidence gathering and documentation.
• Maintain process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and knowledge articles.
• Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
• Ensure contractual obligations, service levels, and operational targets are met.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

 • Maintain effective working relationships with clients, service delivery teams, resolver groups, and leadership.
• Provide clear, concise, and timely written and verbal communications.
• Facilitate operational meetings including Daily Operations Reviews, CAB, PRB, and MIM Reviews.
• Escalate service risks, compliance concerns, and operational issues to management as required.
• Provide training, coaching, and process guidance to support teams and stakeholders.

Key Deliverables

 • Major Incident Coordination & Communication
• Change Advisory Board (CAB) Facilitation
• Problem Review Board (PRB) Facilitation
• Root Cause Analysis Tracking
• Post Incident Reviews (PIR)
• Governance Reporting & Dashboards
• Service Management Compliance Audits
• KPI / SLA / XLA Reporting
• Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement Initiatives

 Required Skills

 • ITIL Foundation Certification (preferred)
• Strong understanding of Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes
• ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platform experience
• Strong analytical and reporting skills
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Experience facilitating governance and operational meetings
• Knowledge of KPI, SLA, OLA, and service management reporting
• Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 skills

 You will be successful in this role if you have:

 Any degree and 2-4 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow HRSD Architect who can design smart HR solutions and lead complex system integrations. If you enjoy solving problems, building automated workflows, and connecting different HR systems together — this role is for you.
 

 What You Will Do 
 • Lead the HR Service Delivery (HRSD) setup on ServiceNow — including Case Management, Employee Center, ESS/MSS, and Life Cycle Events.

• Build integrations between ServiceNow and:
• SAP HR / HCM

• Identity management platforms (IDAM)
• Mobile apps
• Create automations using Integration Hub, APIs, and Flow Designer.
• Ensure HR data security and compliance across the platform.
• Use ServiceNow’s AI capabilities (Now Assist, Co‑pilots) to enhance HR user experience.

 

 What We’re Looking For 
 • 5+ years of total ServiceNow experience.
• Minimum 3 years specifically working with HRSD.
• Strong hands‑on experience with integrations:
• REST, SOAP
• OIDC, SCIM
• Good understanding of HR processes, compliance needs, and employee lifecycle.
• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

 

 Ideal Candidate 
 Someone who has built or designed HRSD setups before, understands how HR systems talk to each other, and can create smooth, secure, automated employee experiences.

 Position Summary 

 Cyber 

 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

 Position Summary

 Level: Manager 

 In this role, you will architect scalable ServiceNow solutions that automate vulnerability intake, prioritization, remediation, and reporting across complex environments. You will work across VR, SIR, CMDB, and ITSM processes to help organizations reduce risk, improve remediation outcomes, and strengthen platform governance.

 Work you'll do

 As an Engineering Manager II on the Cyber Risk Services team, you will be responsible for:

 • Designing and implementing ServiceNow Vulnerability Response solutions, including workflows for vulnerability ingestion, prioritization, assignment, remediation, and closure
• Architecting integrations between ServiceNow, vulnerability scanning tools, CMDB, and ITSM processes using REST APIs, MID Server, Flow Designer, and Integration Hub
• Leading configuration, customization, and scripting activities across VR and SecOps use cases, including rules, automations, dashboards, and reporting
• Translating business and security requirements into technical designs, user stories, and scalable platform solutions for clients
• Providing technical leadership, governance, and support for platform configuration, upgrade planning, documentation, and operational best practices

 The team

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations to address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues, such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

 Qualifications

 Required:

 • 8+ years of ServiceNow experience in administration, development, or platform engineering roles
• 7+ years of experience in ServiceNow design, development, and architecture
• 5+ years of experience implementing or managing ServiceNow SecOps modules, including Vulnerability Response or Security Incident Response
• Experience with ServiceNow configuration, JavaScript or Glide scripting, REST APIs, and MID Server management
• Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Information Technology Service Management, and Common Service Data Model
• Experience integrating vulnerability scanners such as Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7 with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field

Preferred:

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification in SecOps or Vulnerability Response
• CISSP or CISM certification
• Experience with Performance Analytics, Integration Hub, or Application Portfolio Management
• Experience with vulnerability management frameworks such as NIST or ISO 27001

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: General Shift

 Cyber

 As a Security Engineer III, you will support the design, configuration, and implementation of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management solutions that help clients address risk, compliance, and operational needs.  Work you'll do

 As a Security Engineer III on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for:
